calls.title: GrowthBook and Vio.com
calls.summary: Vio is experiencing issues with its current flagging solution on Optimizely, notably reliability and usability problems that hinder non-technical users from effectively running experiments. They seek a lightweight SDK that allows for clear user bucket status and active rollout tracking while maintaining control over evaluation logic. GrowthBook's SDK was presented as a viable option, demonstrating capabilities in local evaluation, detailed rollout tracking, and compatibility with Vio's tech stack. Vio plans to initiate a proof of concept with GrowthBook's open-source SDK before considering enterprise features, focusing on improving their experimentation process and addressing frustrations stemming from Optimizely’s complexity and trust issues.
calls.keywords: feature flagging, SDK, experimentation platform, Optimizely, GrowthBook, proof of concept
calls.action_items:
**Dale French**
Review GrowthBook open source SDK by running a proof of concept to evaluate its flagging capabilities against current needs (16:45)
Decide on potential engagement with GrowthBook enterprise tier after initial team review of the basic solution (17:45)

**James Shannon**
Provide GrowthBook open source resources and documentation to Dale’s team for initial testing and evaluation (16:30)
Remain available to discuss commercial options and enterprise support if Vio decides to scale or requires additional features (19:01)
